Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You drop behind a twist of roots, letting the branches catch at the blow meant for you.

Rules

Action
Reaction
Attribute
None — no roll
Target / range / shape
Self, before a defense roll against an attack dealing physical damage while occupying vegetation that already supplies cover.
Duration
Instant.
Equipment / acquisition
None.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Skill / Defense

Gain 1 Boon to this defense. This is in addition to the existing cover modifier, under normal Boon/Bane rules. It does not grant Hidden or change the vegetation’s cover rating.
